component.name: Suite Sync
component.summary: Your own Suite relay, in the tray

description.p: Sync is the mailbox the Suite apps sync through. It runs on a machine you own — a spare desktop, a home server, the computer you leave on — and it stores encrypted frames it cannot open. It never joins a group and never reads a document.

The tray keeps the relay serving while the window is closed. The window shows the address another device needs, its certificate fingerprint, the relay code to scan and the read-only console. There is no account and no Suite-operated server.
On a machine without a desktop, the same Flatpak runs the relay headless: flatpak run --command=suite-sync run.suite.sync serve.
